goal: Reduce ordinary-motion velocity and scalar-distance errors without the fault regression of PR11. Do not relax current-main promotion criteria.
data_policy: Diagnose and select using all 17 development bags, including the established synthetic faults. Confirm a fixed candidate on all 19 existing validation bags. No final-test database access; no training GNSS or physical refitting. Validation has already been reused and is not an independent test.
development_round1: pair_guard: PR11 correction only with two accepted agreeing wheels; 0.5 s fault holdoff
readout: unmodified inner v5, recursive output-only correction; 0.5 s holdoff, 0.15 s age limit
readout_long: same output correction, 0.25 s age limit
readout_fast: same output correction, 0.25 s holdoff and 0.15 s age limit
readout_direct: output-only model-acceleration times mean held age instead of recursion
invariants: Same input timestamps, arrival order, output grid, reference masks and fault placement
No future inputs, repeated wheel assimilation, GNSS runtime access or fault metadata
Unchanged wheel units, physical calibration and main v5 parameters
Bounded memory and explicit reset behavior
Keep main, PR11, historical freeze, reports and release archive unchanged

acceptance_vs_main_v5.required_gain: at least 2% clean group-macro RMSE OR 5% fault-event group-macro RMSE
acceptance_vs_main_v5.max_per_bag_receiver_clean_regression: max(0.005 m/s, 5% of main v5 RMSE)
acceptance_vs_main_v5.tests: unit, research-integrity and actual installed ROS/offline checks must pass before claiming a merge-ready candidate

reporting: Preserve all attempted variants and failures. Commit selected code and configuration before validation. Report all regressions, exact base/head SHAs and commands in a Russian PR. No claim of statistical significance from bag/receiver win counts. Do not merge or switch the operational default automatically.
